observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence tests and vertical proof

request.full_suite_change_note: The complete suite ran after the projection structure and compaction changes. A subsequent finite elapsed-value upper bound and measurement-limit wording refinement was followed by a complete rerun of the capability-intelligence module.

verified_properties: No diagnostic activity field is added when the session has no diagnostic history or epoch, preserving existing low-budget ECI behavior.
Newest session diagnostic summaries remain bounded, same-session immutable references are validated, and diagnostic witness payloads are not copied.
The current diagnostic epoch is related to the latest history reference without claiming event-window causality.
Response-budget compaction retains the diagnostic summary and an exact validated evidence reference.
A cross-session evidence reference is rejected and its foreign session identity is not exposed.
The Environment vertical proof still completes real provider invocation, protected-scope denial, checkpoint, process restart, handoff, and completion.
outcome.interpretation_limit: Tests establish projection structure, bounds, reference validation, and existing Environment integration behavior; they do not establish that agents discovered or benefited from the new projection.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The full repository suite was followed by a focused complete rerun of the capability-intelligence module after the final numeric-bound refinement; the full suite was not rerun after that small refinement.
The vertical proof is independent verification of existing Environment session composition, not evidence of long-term diagnostic service quality.
No independent later agent activity establishes reduced intervention, successful agent receipt, or long-term burden reduction.
